Cc: GreenAtlantic Finance <accounts@greenatlantic.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — W-8BEN-E and residency certificate attached

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our conversation, I'm sending our completed W-8BEN-E along with a certified Certificate of Tax Residence so Redwood can validate our tax status and proceed with vendor account creation. We are a UK entity (GreenAtlantic Ltd.) and will be paid in USD by PO.

Files attached:
- GreenAtlantic_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf (signed W-8BEN-E, 1 page)
- GreenAtlantic_TaxResidence_Certificate.pdf (notarized certificate, 2 pages)

Can you confirm whether Redwood requires any additional evidence (e.g., UK tax authority letter or apostille) before the procurement team opens a purchase account and issues the first PO? We can also complete any vendor portal forms if you can send a link.

Appreciate your help — hoping to get the first PO in place this month.

Best,
Maria Torres
Head of Finance
GreenAtlantic Ltd.
attachments: GreenAtlantic_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf, GreenAtlantic_TaxResidence_Certificate.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@greenatlantic.co.uk>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — W-8BEN-E and residency certificate attached

Hi Maria,

Thanks — received both attachments and uploaded them to the vendor intake queue. Quick note from tax screening: the W-8BEN-E we received lists GreenAtlantic's foreign TIN, but the TIN on the certificate PDF (page 2) appears truncated in the scan and doesn't match the W-8 form exactly. Before procurement can create the purchase account we need either: a clearer scan of the certificate showing the full TIN, or an alternative verification (HMRC statement or an apostille).

Next steps:
1) If you can re-upload a clean scan of the Certificate of Tax Residence that clearly shows the TIN, please send it to this thread.
2) Alternatively, we can send you a vendor portal invite to upload documents directly — that's our preferred path for traceability. I'll copy the onboarding form in case you'd rather email it back.

I've attached our short Vendor Onboarding Form for fields we need to complete in the PO system. Fill and return when you can.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Can you confirm both: (a) certificate and W-8 match and meet our tax-proof standard, and (b) whether any additional HMRC letter or apostille is required for EU-to-US payments? Once tax signs off, procurement will create the vendor record in Coupa and queue the PO.

Reference: vendor portal record https://redwood.app/vendor/GreenAtlantic and HubSpot HS-123456789.

Irene — I'll hold the account creation step until Naomi confirms. If tax approves today I can fast-track the PO setup tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
